summary: Tara Print and Pack will print and deliver the cartons and labels that Kaveri Retail orders in writing. Kaveri Retail pays each invoice within ninety days of receiving it. Tara Print and Pack cannot print packaging for any other grocery retailer during the agreement and for two years after it ends. Every design, artwork file and printing plate Tara Print and Pack makes belongs to Kaveri Retail as soon as it is made. Only the courts at Bengaluru can decide disputes. Kaveri Retail can deduct 2% of the order value for each day an order is late. Notices go by email.
